objective: Train an image-and-evidence Mesen UI/UX judgment model and export a small ONNX student only after independent evaluation

teacher_policy.scope: mobile UX defect diagnosis only; teacher outputs are proposals, not ground truth
teacher_policy.qualified_teacher_per_axis: Record a pinned model, prompt, and human-reviewed accuracy receipt for every axis before using its outputs as distillation targets; UX defect expertise alone does not qualify a model to judge originality or functionality
teacher_policy.independent_review: Every four-axis label needs an evaluator distinct from its maker and a traceable evidence receipt

abstention: A screenshot without interaction evidence cannot prove functionality; unsupported axes must answer unknown

split_policy.group: site and route family, including all viewports and mutations
split_policy.blind_holdout: sealed before optimization; never used for prompt selection, checkpoint selection, or threshold tuning

training_admission: Pinned source, license, and weight hash receipt for every teacher and base model
Data manifest has zero missing images and no route-family overlap across train, validation, or blind holdout
Each training label records maker, independent evaluator, source artifact hash, and evidence reference
Every teacher is qualified on the particular criterion it labels; unsupported teacher output remains unknown
Model forward pass consumes changed image pixels and changed witness text; no constant text-only fallback
GPU resource and storage admission pass on the selected node

acceptance.reporting: Publish per-axis confusion matrices, abstentions, calibration, route/site breakdowns, model hashes, and the full inference input contract

deployment_rule: No ONNX replacement or completion claim if any predeclared criterion fails or is unmeasured
